metadata.seoDescription: Start free, then pay per editor. Compare the Free, Team and Business plans, or talk to us about Enterprise.

attrs.title: Plans that grow with your team
attrs.sub: Start free, then pay per editor as you grow. Viewers are always free, and every plan includes unlimited presentations.
attrs.note: Prices exclude tax. Cancel any time.

attrs.title: Chosen by 4,000 teams who present for a living

content.text: Everything that differs between the plans, row by row.
Anyone who can change a presentation in your workspace. People who only view, comment or present are free on every plan.

attrs.title: Can I switch between monthly and yearly?

content.text: Yes. Switching to yearly takes effect straight away and we credit what is left of the month; switching back takes effect at renewal.

attrs.title: What happens when the trial ends?

content.text: You choose a plan or stay on Free. Nothing is deleted — presentations over the Free limits become read-only until you upgrade.

attrs.title: Do you offer discounts for education and non-profits?

content.text: Yes: half price on Team and Business for schools, universities and registered non-profits. Write to us from the form below.
From the billing page, any time. You keep your plan until the end of the period you paid for.
Rolling it out to the whole company?
Volume pricing, a security review, a named contact and an onboarding plan for every team. Tell us a little about yours and we will reply within one business day.
